name: Lusha
description: Connect Lusha to Claude to access verified B2B contact and company data without leaving your chat. Lusha is a sales intelligence platform with 300M+ verified contacts, direct emails, phone numbers, and mobile numbers, plus actionable buyer signals used across sales, marketing, and RevOps workflows. Backed by GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27701 compliance. Perfect for building prospect lists, researching accounts before a call, qualifying inbound leads, and natural language prospecting inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lusha to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lusha to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lusha.com/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lusha MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lusha lists 24 MCP tools, including contacts_search, companies_search, prospecting_contact_search, prospecting_contact_enrich, prospecting_company_search, prospecting_company_enrich, prospecting_contact_filters, prospecting_company_filters, account_usage, lookalike_companies, lookalike_contacts, and signals_contacts_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lusha?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lusha in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Lusha requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lusha is developed by Lusha. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
